title: AI compute, networking, and hyperscaler monetization
thesis:
AI infrastructure spending is broadening beyond accelerators into Ethernet networking, advanced
foundry capacity, packaging, memory, data centres, power, cloud, and software. Current supplier and
cloud evidence confirms demand and some monetization. The core risk has shifted from whether capex
exists to whether utilization, pricing, and recurring revenue outgrow depreciation, energy,
competition, and custom-silicon substitution.
discovery_provenance: user seed; Arista Networks; TSMC; Alphabet; NVIDIA fiscal Q1 2027 review and accepted relationship

title: AI-Driven Democratization of Physical Creation
thesis:
Generative 3D systems and AI-assisted CAD could reduce the expertise, time, and marginal cost needed
to turn text, photographs, sketches, or functional requirements into editable geometry. NVIDIA's
research progression is directional evidence: Magic3D reported roughly 40 minutes per prompt in
2023, while LATTE3D reported feed-forward generation in about 400 milliseconds in 2024. That is not
proof of engineering-grade geometry. It does show that one historical bottleneck—creating a digital
object at all—is becoming cheaper and faster.
discovery_provenance: user seed; primary technical, issuer, exchange, and regulatory evidence

title: AI infrastructure and power bottlenecks
thesis:
Rapid data-centre construction is raising concentrated electricity demand faster than some grids,
generation equipment, transformers, switchgear, cooling systems, and interconnections can expand.
Suppliers with qualified products, available capacity, disciplined contracts, and strong cash
conversion can benefit from multi-year backlogs. The theme is not sufficient on its own: current
growth expectations are high, backlogs can be cancelled or delayed, and capacity expansion can
turn scarcity into oversupply.
discovery_provenance: user seed; IEA Energy and AI; issuer filings and releases; linked security research including Powell Industries

title: AI-native drug-discovery platforms
thesis:
AI models linked to proprietary biological and chemical data and automated wet labs can shorten
some discovery loops and improve candidate selection. Pharma investment and regulatory engagement
confirm adoption, but clinical translation—not model output—is the economic bottleneck. Platform
companies must demonstrate repeatable milestone revenue or owned-pipeline value before cash burn,
dilution, and partner bargaining power consume the benefit.
discovery_provenance: user seed; FDA; Eli Lilly; Recursion

title: AI-native SMB financial operating systems
thesis:
Platforms that combine authoritative accounting, payroll, tax, commerce, and payment data can use
domain-constrained agents to automate SMB workflows and attach adjacent services. The moat is not a
chat interface: it is trusted records, permissioned actions, compliance logic, distribution, expert
escalation, and liability management. General-purpose agents, open data, free substitutes, and
weak SMB credit can compress pricing or move value outside the application vendor.
discovery_provenance: user seed; Intuit; IRS; CFPB; Lemonade 2025 Form 10-K; Lemonade Q2 2026 Form 10-Q

title: Anduril product-company disruption and future-IPO exposure
thesis:
Anduril's significance is a defence business-model test: finance reusable products and software
before a bespoke program, retain intellectual property, sell deployable systems, and use common
Lattice and manufacturing infrastructure across programs. Current contract evidence shows movement
from prototypes toward enterprise procurement and production. Anduril remains private, however, so
an IPO thesis lacks audited public economics, a filing, or an investable instrument.
discovery_provenance: user seed; US Army and Department of Defense; Anduril; Palantir

title: Cable broadband convergence and leveraged FCF
thesis:
US cable operators are using mobile bundles, simpler pricing, rural expansion, and network upgrades
to defend broadband relationships. Mobile growth is real, but current results do not yet show broad
fixed-broadband stabilization. Highly leveraged equity can rerate sharply if losses slow and capex
normalizes, yet the same leverage magnifies competitive, refinancing, and merger-integration risk.
discovery_provenance: user seed; Charter Communications; Comcast

title: Commercial space infrastructure and geospatial data
thesis:
Government demand for proliferated, resilient space systems and commercial lunar services supports
a listed stack of launch, spacecraft, components, sensors, and data. Backlog and launch cadence are
necessary but insufficient: reliability, fixed-price execution, capital needs, customer
concentration, and recurring service revenue determine per-share value.
discovery_provenance: user seed; NASA; U.S. Space Force; Rocket Lab

title: Critical minerals and structural copper scarcity
thesis:
Grid expansion, data centres, electric vehicles, renewables, and industrial electrification can
raise copper demand faster than long-lead mine supply. The durable claim is a constrained project
pipeline and disciplined capital cycle, not a perpetual one-way spot-price forecast. Low-cost,
long-life producers may capture upside; smelters without secure concentrate and manufacturers
without pass-through pricing can instead lose margin.
discovery_provenance: user seed; IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2026; issuer filings and releases

title: Critical minerals and the lithium cycle
thesis:
Lithium's 2025-to-2026 rebound reflects both a cyclical recovery from oversupply and stronger
battery demand, especially stationary storage. A late-decade shortfall remains plausible because
the downturn cut investment and projects require financing and commissioning time. The investable
claim is not that spot prices rise continuously: supply restarts, contract lags, chemistry changes,
recycling, and capital intensity can separate commodity prices from shareholder returns.
discovery_provenance: user seed; IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2026; issuer filings

title: Cybersecurity resilience and geopolitical continuity
thesis:
Cybersecurity is increasingly an operational-continuity and regulatory requirement rather than a
purely discretionary IT project. State-linked intrusion campaigns and EU risk-management mandates
support durable spending, but attractive investment returns require vendors to turn that priority
into retained recurring revenue, cash flow, and trust without valuation or platform-consolidation
risk overwhelming the growth.
discovery_provenance: user seed; CISA; European Commission; CrowdStrike

title: Defense and aerospace replenishment cycle
thesis:
European rearmament, allied stockpile replenishment, and demand for air defence, missiles, sensors,
and engines can support a multi-year production and service cycle. Public budgets and current
backlogs confirm demand, but appropriations do not automatically become profitable revenue:
contract structure, capacity, suppliers, labor, export approvals, execution, and valuation decide
shareholder returns.
discovery_provenance: user seed; European Defence Agency 2026 data; RTX Q2 2026 release

title: Defensive consumer cash-return resilience
thesis: Recurring grocery and branded-food demand can support operating cash flow through weak consumer volumes and input-cost cycles, but defensive demand does not automatically produce defensive shareholder returns. Cash transmission depends on retaining volume while managing price and mix, funding necessary capital expenditure and leases, containing interest and leverage burdens, and distributing only genuinely surplus cash. Ahold Delhaize currently provides the stronger evidence of the mechanism; Nomad Foods shows that margin recovery and cash conversion can coexist with material volume and earnings pressure.
discovery_provenance: Ahold Delhaize, Nomad Foods and Domino's Q2 2026 issuer results

title: Digital attention, gaming, and consumer ecosystems
thesis:
Creator platforms can compound when more useful content raises engagement and monetization, which
funds creator rewards, safety, infrastructure, and discovery. Engagement alone is not sufficient:
bookings or subscriptions, cohort retention, creator earnings, free cash flow after platform costs,
and share-count discipline must improve together. Safety and regulatory controls are core operating
costs and trust inputs, not optional overlays.
discovery_provenance: user seed; Roblox SEC filings and issuer releases

title: Digital finance and crypto rails
thesis:
US stablecoin law, tokenized-securities guidance, and growing regulated platform activity improve
the foundation for continuous settlement, custody, payments, and tokenization. Platforms with
distribution, compliance, liquidity, and trusted custody can diversify beyond spot trading. Their
economics remain exposed to crypto prices and volumes, interest rates, reserve-income sharing,
take-rate compression, cyber loss, regulatory implementation, and stock-based compensation.
discovery_provenance: user seed; U.S. Congress; Federal Reserve; SEC; Coinbase

title: Crude-product dislocation and refining margins
thesis:
Crude supply can recover faster than refinery throughput and product exports, lowering feedstock
prices while gasoline and diesel remain tight. Complex refiners with reliable operations and useful
regional configurations can capture elevated cracks even when crude markets move toward surplus.
The opportunity is cyclical and operational: refinery restarts, weaker demand, outages at the
selected company, or regulatory costs can normalize earnings quickly.
discovery_provenance: user seed; IEA Oil Market Report July 2026; Valero releases

title: EU Digital Product Passport compliance infrastructure
thesis:
The EU Digital Product Passport is moving from legislation into operating infrastructure. It can
create recurring demand for product identifiers, lifecycle data, registry integration, access
controls, and compliance workflows across regulated value chains. The regulatory need is real, but
open standards, a public registry, decentralized storage, and long implementation periods may
commoditize the stack or keep vendor revenue immaterial.
discovery_provenance: user seed; European Commission; EUR-Lex

title: Humanoid robotics and embodied-AI component supply chain
thesis:
Industrial robots, humanoids, and autonomous machines can increase demand for motion control,
sensors, edge compute, connectors, power electronics, batteries, copper, and rare-earth magnets.
The investable claim is narrower than unit growth: qualified suppliers must show material content,
repeat paid deployments, uptime, and margins. Conventional industrial automation is already scaled;
general-purpose humanoid economics remain early.
discovery_provenance: user seed; International Federation of Robotics; NVIDIA; MP Materials; NVIDIA fiscal Q1 2027 review and accepted relationship

title: Japan strategic-investment value chain
thesis:
Japan's Takaichi government has formally selected 17 strategic fields and is developing multi-year
public-private investment roadmaps spanning supply support, procurement, regulation, talent, and
international expansion. This improves policy visibility for selected semiconductor, AI, defence,
space, power, automation, and advanced-technology suppliers. Equity value still requires funded
programs to become company orders, profitable backlog, and cash flow rather than policy targets.
discovery_provenance: user seed; Prime Minister's Office of Japan; METI; Ministry of Defense

title: Gold and cash-generative miners as a macro hedge
thesis:
Gold can diversify portfolios exposed to inflation, geopolitical shocks, and reserve-system risk,
while low-cost miners add operating leverage and distributable cash flow. The two exposures are not
equivalent: bullion avoids mine execution, tax, and cost risk, whereas miners can compound or destroy
the metal-price benefit. Record metal prices also raise mean-reversion and valuation risk.
discovery_provenance: user seed; Federal Reserve; World Gold Council; Newmont releases

title: Mobility-platform network economics and autonomy
thesis:
A scaled mobility marketplace can use rider demand, driver and courier supply, routing, pricing,
payments, membership, delivery and advertising to increase trips and cash generation without owning
every vehicle. Autonomous fleets can strengthen that network if third-party operators need demand,
dispatch and utilization, but can harm it if vehicle providers vertically integrate and bypass the
marketplace. The investable mechanism is therefore network monetization after insurance, incentive,
regulatory, stock-compensation and autonomy-investment costs—not trip growth alone.
discovery_provenance: Uber Q2 2026 issuer results

title: Nearshoring and friendshoring manufacturing capacity
thesis:
Trade-policy uncertainty, continuity mandates, and manufacturing incentives can redirect selected
capacity toward Mexico, North America, India, and parts of Southeast Asia. The investable signal is
not an announcement count: it is conversion into operating plants, occupied industrial space,
cross-border freight, supplier utilization, and cash earnings.
discovery_provenance: user seed; USTR; Government of India; Ternium

title: Nuclear expansion and uranium fuel-cycle bottlenecks
thesis:
Nuclear construction and life extension are increasing demand for uranium and fuel services, while
conversion and enrichment capacity are more concentrated and slower to expand than the mining-only
narrative implies. Contracted, operating suppliers can retain strategic value, but reactor growth
does not automatically translate into near-term equity returns because contract lags, operational
interruptions, project execution, and valuation determine cash realization.
discovery_provenance: user seed; IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2026; Cameco releases

title: Precision biology and healthcare automation
thesis:
AI-enabled discovery, synthetic biology, diagnostics, laboratory automation, and robotic procedures
can shorten individual research or care workflows. They do not yet establish a common improvement
in clinical success or economics. The investable version therefore requires company-level proof:
validated outcomes, recurring consumables or data revenue, regulatory clearance, reimbursement,
and cash conversion before funding needs exhaust the option value.
discovery_provenance: user seed; FDA; Intuitive Surgical

title: Solar, storage, and grid-flexibility reset
thesis:
Electric-load growth, grid congestion, and the need to balance variable generation can create a
multi-year demand tailwind for storage, grid equipment, power management, and selected solar
suppliers. The investable claim is narrower than a sector recovery: only companies that convert
backlogs into cash at durable margins, control inventories and warranty exposure, and retain access
to financing should benefit. Module shipment growth or announced capacity alone is not enough.
discovery_provenance: user seed; IEA Electricity 2026; EIA; Federal Reserve; IRS; issuer releases

title: Sovereign small-drone and trusted-component supply chains
thesis:
High battlefield attrition and growing public-safety and industrial use are increasing demand for
small drones, counter-drone systems, and their components. US and EU policy is explicitly favoring
trusted domestic or allied supply. Durable public-market value nevertheless requires volume orders,
local component content, competitive unit economics, and margins that survive rapid redesign and
commoditisation.
discovery_provenance: user seed; European Commission; UK Ministry of Defence; US executive policy; FAA

title: Structural silver deficit
thesis:
Six consecutive annual deficits and reliance on above-ground bullion can support silver, but the
2026 evidence is not a one-way industrial-demand story. High prices are already driving
photovoltaic thrifting and substitution, weaker price-sensitive consumption, more recycling, and
some demand destruction. The investable case is therefore a volatile precious-metal and inventory
tightness thesis, not a simple perpetual scarcity extrapolation.
discovery_provenance: user seed; U.S. Geological Survey; Silver Institute

title: Terafab and the vertically coordinated AI hardware stack
thesis:
Terafab is an investable industrial-stack idea only as a staged, hybrid buildout. Current primary
records support a proposed Texas campus, a SpaceX goal of one terawatt of annual compute-hardware
production, logic, memory and advanced-packaging ambitions, shared SpaceX/Tesla engineering, and a
proposed Intel contribution. They do not establish a finished fab, a production process, binding
customer volumes, competitive yield, or Nvidia silicon production.

title: Wide-bandgap power semiconductors
thesis:
Silicon carbide and gallium nitride can enable higher-voltage, higher-frequency, denser, and more
efficient power conversion in AI data centres, EVs, chargers, and inverters. NVIDIA's 800 VDC
architecture creates a concrete new design cycle, but technical suitability does not guarantee
supplier returns: qualification, yield, utilization, packaging, price competition, and capital
intensity determine whether content growth becomes free cash flow.
